Kir Royale

Served at: New Year's Day · Magic Flute

Serves 1Prep 2 min

A sophisticated and festive cocktail, the Kir Royale elevates sparkling wine with a touch of blackcurrant liqueur. It's a perfect elegant toast for New Year's Day celebrations, adding a touch of French chic to your festive gatherings, and an ideal aperitif for an evening of cultural enjoyment, such as attending "The Magic Flute."

Ingredients

  • 0.5 fluid ounce (15 ml) Crème de Cassis (blackcurrant liqueur)
  • 5 fluid ounces (150 ml) chilled dry sparkling wine (e.g., Brut Champagne, Cava, Prosecco)
  • Optional: 1 fresh raspberry or lemon twist for garnish

Method

  1. Pour the Crème de Cassis into a chilled flute glass.
  2. Slowly top with the chilled sparkling wine.
  3. If desired, garnish with a fresh raspberry or a lemon twist.
  4. Serve immediately.

Tips

  • Use a good quality, dry sparkling wine for the best flavor balance.
  • Chill both the Crème de Cassis and the sparkling wine thoroughly before serving.
  • For a non-alcoholic version, use blackcurrant syrup and sparkling cider or non-alcoholic sparkling wine.
